facts.statement: Special discounts on furniture and decor items ran in a sale that began Saturday, February 16, 2013 at 12:01 AM PST.
facts.quote: from Saturday, February 16, 2013 at 12:01 AM PST through Monday, February 18, 2013 at 11:59 PM PST

facts.statement: The Home Decor Sale ended Monday, February 18, 2013 at 11:59 PM PST.
facts.quote: through Monday, February 18, 2013 at 11:59 PM PST

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Home Decor Sale)
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing a home decor sale. It gives the sale window (February 16 to February 18, 2013, Pacific time) and says furniture and decor items were discounted, with the headline promising 50% off everything for the home. The page does not list individual item prices or the discount on each item.
